v2_architecture.NAVIGATION: empirical method-conditioned navigation nuisance from CD169, with unseen-survey validation required
v2_architecture.COVERAGE: hierarchical product->survey->raw-swath->ping/beam coverage booleans; no promotion between levels without evidence
v2_architecture.MULTIBEAM_PROCESSING: explicit processing state, SVP/SSP state, channel QC lineage, raw-vs-corrected separation
v2_architecture.SONAR_GEOMETRY: vehicle pose + altitude + local terrain -> side/cross-track/slant/sample distribution with propagated navigation uncertainty
v2_architecture.HYDROACOUSTIC_INSTRUMENT: response-epoch binding + raw/corrected parallel metrics + availability/missingness state
v2_architecture.MORPHOLOGY: remains downstream and blind; cannot feed back into navigation, coverage, response or processing calibration

unseen_validation_requirements.navigation: different towfish survey with native vehicle navigation
unseen_validation_requirements.coverage: different survey with authoritative footprint and preferably ping/beam geometry
unseen_validation_requirements.multibeam_processing: different raw multibeam acquisition with corrected/processed reference and usable sound-speed provenance
unseen_validation_requirements.hydroacoustic: different event/station set with response metadata and independent event truth
unseen_validation_requirements.morphology: known-target or strongly independently constrained geometry withheld until predictions are frozen
